info.title: MarkClean AI — Web-to-LLM Markdown, Table & RAG Chunking API
info.description: Convert any URL or raw HTML into clean, token-optimized GitHub-Flavored Markdown, structured JSON/CSV tables, OpenGraph/JSON-LD metadata, and semantic RAG chunks. Cuts LLM token costs by 65–90% for AI agents, LangChain/LlamaIndex pipelines, and n8n/Make automations.

post.summary: Extract clean LLM Markdown, JSON tables & RAG chunks from URL or HTML
post.description: Fetches a URL (or accepts raw HTML) and strips DOM clutter, ads, scripts, and cookie banners. Returns clean Markdown with YAML frontmatter, structured JSON/CSV tables, and semantic RAG chunks.

url.description: Public HTTP/HTTPS URL to fetch and extract

html.description: Optional raw HTML string to parse directly instead of fetching a URL

includeImages.description: Preserve image references in Markdown output

focusMainContent.description: Automatically strip nav, footer, sidebar, and cookie banners

chunkSizeTokens.description: Target maximum token count per semantic RAG chunk

200.description: Clean Markdown, metadata, extracted tables, RAG chunks, and token savings telemetry

get.summary: Extract clean LLM Markdown from a URL via GET query parameters

post.summary: Extract all HTML tables from a URL or HTML as structured JSON, CSV & Markdown
post.description: Dedicated endpoint for financial, pricing, and benchmark scraping. Extracts every HTML table on a page into clean JSON object arrays, RFC-4180 CSV strings, and GFM pipe tables.

200.description: Array of extracted tables in JSON, CSV, and Markdown formats

post.summary: Split Markdown or text into heading-aware, token-bounded RAG chunks
post.description: Splits long Markdown documents along H1–H3 semantic boundaries while respecting your maximum token window and token overlap for vector embeddings.

markdown.example:

sourceUrl.description: Optional canonical source URL attached to every returned chunk for traceable citations

repeatTableHeaders.description: Automatically repeat Markdown table headers across split chunks so LLM agents never lose column context

200.description: Array of semantic RAG chunks with token counts
